gloss: individual customer; private customer; retail customer

definitions.gloss: individual customer; private customer; retail customer
definitions.explanation: A customer who is a private individual rather than a business entity or corporate client. Used in hospitality, banking, retail, and service industries to distinguish individual clients from corporate or group customers.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Reservations from individual customers are increasing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧ (individual, personal) and ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (customer, guest). Common in business contexts, especially hospitality, finance, and retail.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}{向|む}け: aimed at individual customers
- {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: handling individual customers
- {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to increase individual customers
- {個人|こじん}{客|きゃく}⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧: focused on individual customers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{団体|だんたい}{客|きゃく}→団体客：17069_dantaikyaku⟧: group customer — the natural opposite, visitors coming as an organized group
- ⟦{法人|ほうじん}→法人：13298_houjin⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧: corporate customer — a company or organization as client
- ⟦{常連|じょうれん}{客|きゃく}→常連客：26808_jourenkyaku⟧: regular customer — a returning patron regardless of individual or group status
